* '''Playtest''' ([[Kamino: Clone Birthing Center (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-kaminoclonebirthingcenter-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/kaminoclonebirthingcenter.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “During your deploy phase, your clone here may move to a site you occupy for free.” Dark Side: “If you initiate battle here, add one battle destiny. Fetts may move to and from here for free.”
* '''Original''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-kaminoclonebirthingcenter-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/kaminoclonebirthingcenter.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “During your deploy phase, your clone here may move to a site you occupy for free.” Dark Side: “If you initiate battle here, add one battle destiny. Fetts may move to and from here for free.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; the image is now stored as a landscape site card (it was stored upright on 1 August); same words.
